caption: The drawing depicts a wooden four-poster bed frame with a headboard and no mattress. The bed frame is composed of four tall, turned posts positioned at each corner, each ending in a pointed finial. The headboard is curved and solid, connecting the two rear posts. The wooden frame features side rails and horizontal slats to support a mattress. The overall color of the bed is brown, representing a natural wood tone, with shading to indicate depth and texture. The drawing is enclosed in a thin, black rectangular border and the background is a plain, off-white color. The lower right corner of the drawing contains the text "FRANCIS LAW DURAND."
title: Doll's Bed
